item.text:
This pass found a seventh defect of the same untrusted-input class as Finding 6.

**Finding 7: a short snapshot chunk crashes the receiver**

`getHeaderFromFirstChunk` ([internal/rsm/rwv.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/internal/rsm/rwv.go:383)) panics ("first chunk is too small") when a streamed snapshot's first chunk is shorter than the 1024-byte header. The validator runs inline on the network receive path — `transport.(*TCP).serveConn` → `chunk.Unmarshal` → chunk handler (`chunks.Add`, wired at `transport.go:229`) → `Chunk.addLocked` (`chunk.go:212`) → `SnapshotValidator.AddChunk` → `getHeaderFromFirstChunk` — so a malformed chunk from a peer crashes the process:

```
Chunk.Add panicked on a short first chunk: first chunk is too small
--- FAIL: TestAuditShortFirstChunkDoesNotPanic
```

Returning `(nil, nil, false)` instead of panicking in the fix-verification copy makes the reproduction pass (`Chunk.Add` returns false), which is the behaviour the validator already uses for other bad input.

**State**

Seven findings, all reproduced on the unmodified tree and all fixed in `audit/diag-fixes/`:

- F1 `(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` misses the engine wakeup
- F2 `handleCandidateReadIndex` records a dropped ReadIndex twice
- F3 `pb.Update.HasUpdate` ignores `DroppedReadIndexes`
- F4 `plugin/chan.ChanTransportFactory.Validate` panics
- F5 logger cache ignores the monkey flag
- F6 crafted batch/message frames panic the process (live NodeHost reproduction)
- F7 short snapshot chunk panics the receiver

31 audit tests: 22 negative-result/characterisation passes, 9 deliberate reproductions.

[report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) (842 lines) documents all seven with evidence, fix verification, inventory and command log. The audited tree remains byte-identical to `../source`.
